comparison.objective: Measure tyre tread depth with a contact gauge and return it to its rest; candidate rejects open cartons while passing closed cartons.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2133 tests precise probe placement, simultaneous foot seating, controlled axial pressing and extraction without disturbing a friction-held reading. Candidate tests moving-target body grasp and level loaded transport around flaps.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2133 requires verified groove seating, a reading within 0.8 mm, and released stable return to the rest. Candidate instead grades carton clearance, content retention, reject-tray placement and untouched downstream passage.
comparison.reason: Contact metrology and reading preservation are unrelated to selective conveyor rejection beyond generic grasp-and-place.
